objective: Implement the complete bounded walking skeleton in one Builder branch: runtime preflight for worker and validation processes, stateless supervisor and fixed CLI/launchd launcher, strict Claude worker/reviewer adapter, focused tests, and authority/recovery documentation.
acceptance_criteria: Clean worktrees run worker and declared validation commands through the existing root runtime without creating a venv, symlink, untracked setup file, or installing dependencies.

A supervisor tick takes one OS lock, deterministically selects eligible active Builder initiatives, launches no more than two canonical runs, and returns truthful receipts; duplicate ticks do nothing.

Supervisor CLI exposes only fixed tick/status commands; launchd generation uses RunAtLoad, StartInterval 900, no KeepAlive, safe PATH, canonical root, and fixed logs; tests do not install the service.

Claude adapter supports strict worker/reviewer contracts with Sonnet worker, Opus reviewer, fake CLI tests, reviewer immutability, exit 75 for unavailable executable/auth with no output/change, and no fallback.
Builder remains the only durable authority; publication remains manual; Discord is documented as typed projection/control only with no shell, approval, publication, or merge path.
Focused runtime, supervisor, adapter, CLI, launchd, Builder-run, and continuity tests pass without a live Claude request.
validation_commands: python3.12 -m pytest tests/test_builder_supervisor.py tests/test_builder_run.py tests/test_builder_cli.py tests/test_desktop_launchd.py -q
